title: Many asked for it, so I finally Open Sourced it. Now, you can create fully functional RTS units with sentence using AI.
author: uskyeeeee
selftext:
I previously developed a prototype of this game in the Starcraft 2 Editor and later remade it in Unity. It was played by hundreds of thousands of players, which was amazing.
However, whenever I talked to players, their #1 request was always: "Can you add this specific unit I imagined?" They had wild, creative ideas. But for the sake of game balance and my own sanity, I couldn't fulfill every request.
That's when I realized something: The real fun wasn't just playing the game—it was making it.
Developing a game feels like playing an open-world sandbox RPG. You set your own short-term and long-term goals, find creative ways to achieve them, and get instant dopamine hits when things work. I wanted to share that "creator's joy" with everyone.
Enter the AI Era.
We know AI is powerful. It can generate models (SVG, pixel, voxel), animation, music, code, and UI. But it creates chaos when the codebase gets too large. To fix this, we need a decoupled framework where AI can code within strict boundaries. It turns out, the RTS genre is the perfect framework for this.
Try it yourself:
I’ve set this up on AI Studio for everyone to fork and develop. You can experience the thrill of creating a brand-new unit just by typing natural language.
For example, try using a prompt like this:
Create a new unit: a Sniper. He should have a very long attack range (150% of a Tank's range) and high damage (capable of killing a Marine in one hit), but a slow attack speed. His basic attacks should be projectile-based.
He also needs a unique active ability: he fires a 'Super Bullet' in the direction he is facing. The bullet should travel a long distance and damage all enemies it touches (piercing effect). Please make the visual effects (VFX) for this skill look cool and flashy. The cost of this Sniper is 15.
For his animations, reference the Marine, but create movement and attack animations that differ slightly to better fit the 'Sniper' persona (e.g., more steady and deliberate).
Boom. You just made a Sniper.
I really want to see what you guys can come up with. Please share the links to your creations in the comments below!
https://ai.studio/apps/drive/1KoWYx-0boFJ20BzOR55slmlBCg8R4OD9
